decisions.conflict: Glass-filled virgin polymers provide excellent drop resistance and durability during use but severely hinder mechanical recycling and material recovery at end-of-life.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (t), page 80: lightweight design and reduction of material consumption through high-strength materials
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (h), page 79: use or content of recycled materials and recovery of materials
decisions.chief_resolution: Select a high-recycle-content PC/ABS blend optimized through structural ribbing to achieve lightweight design and high recyclability while maintaining structural integrity.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of post-consumer recycled PC/ABS suppliers that can guarantee mechanical properties under drop-test specifications without requiring glass-fiber reinforcement.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal inserts with machine screws
decisions.conflict: Ultrasonic welding reduces manufacturing costs and part count but prevents non-destructive disassembly, making repair and component recovery impossible.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance through non-destructive disassembly
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (e), page 79: avoidance of technical solutions detrimental to repair and recycling
decisions.chief_resolution: Use standard threaded fasteners mating with brass inserts to allow repeated, non-destructive disassembly using common tools.
decisions.design_action: Verify the compatibility of standard ISO metric screw sizes with the housing wall thickness to ensure repeated disassembly cycles do not strip the threads.

decisions.conflict: Brushed DC motors are cheaper to manufacture and use simpler control electronics, but have a shorter technical lifetime due to brush wear, leading to premature product failure.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product as expressed through technical lifetime and resistance to ageing
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: use or consumption of energy and efficiency during the use phase
decisions.chief_resolution: Specify a high-efficiency Brushless DC (BLDC) motor to maximize energy efficiency during use and extend the technical lifetime of the tool.
decisions.design_action: Check the availability of standardized BLDC motor form factors from multiple suppliers to avoid single-source lock-in and ensure long-term spare parts availability.

options_evaluated: Active fan cooling integrated on motor shaft
decisions.conflict: Open ventilation slots facilitate excellent passive cooling but expose the internal electronics to dust and moisture, reducing reliability and lifetime in harsh environments.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of components against environmental stresses
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: energy efficiency and impact of physical factors on product efficiency
decisions.chief_resolution: Implement an active cooling fan integrated directly onto the motor shaft combined with a dust-filtering mesh over the intake vents to balance thermal dissipation with environmental protection.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the feasibility of using a removable, washable mesh filter design that can be cleaned by the end-user without requiring complete disassembly of the tool housing.

decisions.conflict: A fully integrated monobloc design minimizes spatial volume and assembly complexity but forces the disposal of the entire tool if a single component like the trigger switch fails.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance through modularity and standard components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, and refurbishment through standard components
decisions.chief_resolution: Design a modular cartridge architecture where the battery pack, motor-gearbox assembly, and switch PCB are independent modules that can be slid out and replaced individually.
decisions.design_action: Verify that the electrical connections between modules utilize standardized, pluggable connectors rather than soldered wires to facilitate toolless module replacement.

decisions.conflict: Integrated pouch batteries allow for a more compact and ergonomic handle design but prevent easy battery replacement when the cells degrade, causing premature product obsolescence.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and lifetime of components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (e), page 79: avoidance of technical solutions detrimental to repair and refurbishment
decisions.chief_resolution: Utilize a standardized, user-removable cylindrical 18650 battery pack with an integrated battery management system (BMS) that communicates state-of-health data.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the regulatory and safety compliance requirements for shipping and handling user-replaceable lithium-ion battery packs within the EU market.
